text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it upgraded PairGain Technologies Inc to outperform from neutral.
-- said the recent weakness in PairGain's shares presents a "compelling" buying opportunity.
-- said PairGain is likely to deliver strong first quarter earnings that may exceed its estimate of $0.17 a share.
-- raised the full year 1997 estimate to $0.78 a share from $0.76 a share and increased the 1998 estimate to $1.03 a share from $1.00 a share.
-- said the 12-month price range is $30-$35 a share.
-- said PairGain will likely post compound earnings growth of over 60 percent through 1998 and over 35 percent longer term.
